quest.title: Park Soundscape Walk
quest.invitation: Take a 10-minute stroll in your park to listen to natural sounds without headphones.
steps: Walk slowly along a familiar path, noticing sounds you hear without focusing on one.
Pause at a quiet spot to identify three distinct sounds you hear clearly.
Return to your starting point, reflecting on how sounds changed during your walk.
quest.reflection: How did the sounds you heard shift from your starting point to the end of your walk?

quest.title: Balcony Quiet Moments
quest.invitation: Take 5 minutes to quietly observe your balcony from a seated spot.
steps: Notice three different colors you see in the immediate surroundings without touching anything.
Identify one sound that is currently happening near you and describe it simply.
Feel the temperature of the air on your skin and note how it feels compared to your last observation.
quest.reflection: How does the quiet observation change your sense of the present moment?
